authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our compliance research team verifies obligations and data fields against EUR-Lex and official EU sources.

editorial.how_we_test: Every date, obligation, and data field is cited from EUR-Lex and official sources. Claims are labeled with a last-verified date. Unverified claims are explicitly labeled.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We are supported by vendor sponsorship and a paid readiness toolkit. We do not sell compliance software.
editorial.corrections: Corrections are made promptly with a visible update note on the affected page.
